q: How can I volunteer or mentor?
a: Use the Get involved form and tell us what you do. We match mentors to labs by skill: visual arts, music, design, digital media, enterprise, or wellbeing.

q: Can my organization partner with REINA?
a: Yes. We partner on venues, funding, outreach, skills, and media. Start with the partner form and we will set up a call.
